name: Fortune by personality type
summary: Today's fortune from your birth date (Korean saju and Western sun sign), read through your four-letter personality type (16 types). For entertainment; not advice.

type.description: a four-letter personality type code such as INTJ or ENFP

input_help: type: a four-letter personality type code such as INTJ or ENFP; age: full years 0-110; today defaults to today in Asia/Seoul. The birth date is a sample drawn from your age, not your real birthday.

rules: profile first: the sample birth date makes the given age today (today - (age+1) years < date <= today - age years) and is drawn by the contract's seed rule, so the same input on the same day gives the same date and words

western and saju read the sample date directly and calendar converts it (no hour: three pillars); synthesis blends them with the four letters by the personality-fortune agent's fixed rule table (our own mapping for fun); no model writes it

every answer starts with 'For entertainment; not advice.', says the birth date is a sample, says the four-letter types are used descriptively and not affiliated with any test publisher, and never states or advises on health, money, legal or medical matters, nor uses frightening words
only the type and the age are received; the raw input never reaches logs, the ledger, evidence or cache keys

demand: A direct user request (11-17). Measured: external asks 0 in 30 days (Explore queries are not stored as text and cannot be counted), catalog supply 9 (no x402); public interest: the four-letter types as a common language among Gen Z in Korea and Japan (Korea Times 2026-04, The Star 2025-10-10) (growth team, 11-17).

Five roles, our offline substitutes in every step (personality-profile and personality-fortune are new, agent team the agent team's 16-type branch e692d846; korean-lunar, western-sign and saju-pillars are shared with daily-fortune-brief, unchanged).
